context: Extend the lifecycle boundary without changing worktree-remove. Resolve canonical target identity, refresh PR and base evidence, query controller release evidence, and emit bounded human and JSON previews. Accept no list, glob, age, classification bucket, or branch-only sweep.
description: Add make worktree-finish as preview-only for one exact absolute path and expected full branch-tip OID. Repeat every structural, ownership, cleanliness, exact PR, base, head, merge-commit, and remote evidence check. Never trust a saved audit. Show the exact proposed normal worktree removal and expected-old-OID local ref deletion while performing no mutation.

anti_patterns.dont: Accept lists, globs, ages, or branch-only input
anti_patterns.instead: Require one canonical path and expected OID
Repeat every check at preview time

anti_patterns.dont: Hide apply behind an undocumented flag

preserves.behavior: Active, foreign, dirty, locked, detached, missing, moved, ambiguous, or API-uncertain targets are rejected.
Every preview uses fresh evidence and an expected full OID.
Preview changes no worktree, branch, ref, lock, PR, remote, tracker, or controller state.
worktree-remove retains existing behavior and keeps the branch.

verifications.command: if git diff --unified=0 origin/develop...HEAD -- scripts make | rg -n '^\+.*(git worktree remove|git update-ref -d|branch -D)'; then exit 1; fi
